lines.zh: 我这么矮，走路也像滚
lines.en: I am so low that walking looks like rolling

lines.zh: 圆身子立在角落里，没挪过
lines.en: A round body in the corner, never moved

lines.zh: 从没人给我安排过一条路
lines.en: Nobody ever gave me a route

lines.zh: 我脚底下只有一块地毯
lines.en: There is only a rug under my feet

lines.zh: 有人把它卷起来，把我搬走了
lines.en: Someone rolled it up and carried me off

lines.zh: 我不是走过去，是被推过来
lines.en: I was not walking, I was pushed here

lines.zh: 地毯的边沿被我压出一道沟
lines.en: The rug edge has a groove where I press

lines.zh: 圆滚滚的，重心很低
lines.en: Round and low, my balance sits deep

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，灰被清了一道
lines.en: Where I have been, the dust is cleared

lines.zh: 门框比我还高一点
lines.en: The door frame stands a little taller than I do

lines.zh: 这一路我都是滚着来的
lines.en: I came here rolling the whole way

lines.zh: 你要看走路，看我脚底那道痕
lines.en: For walking, look at the trail under my feet

lines.zh: 我坐在角落里，圆脸冲着屋子
lines.en: I sit in the corner, round face toward the room

lines.zh: 这张脸印得很简单，笑得很实在
lines.en: A simple printed face with an honest smile

lines.zh: 我不到桌子高
lines.en: I am not as tall as the table

lines.zh: 身上有点掉色，尤其耳朵
lines.en: The color is rubbing off, especially the ears

lines.zh: 有人小时候抱过我
lines.en: Someone hugged me as a child

lines.zh: 我不会转脖子，整个身子一起转
lines.en: I cannot turn my neck, I turn all of me

lines.zh: 这间餐厅里，我最不起眼
lines.en: In this diner I am the least noticed

lines.zh: 灯照着地板，我躲在阴影里
lines.en: The lamp lights the floor, I hide in the shade

lines.zh: 肚子里是空的，一敲就响
lines.en: I am empty inside, one knock rings

lines.zh: 我听得见每一句闲聊
lines.en: I hear every scrap of small talk

lines.zh: 这个角落的木头有点潮
lines.en: The wood in this corner is a little damp

lines.zh: 我数着地板的缝
lines.en: I count the seams in the floorboards

lines.zh: 我这样的小东西，最容易忘
lines.en: A little thing like me is the easiest to forget

lines.zh: 我这一坐，能坐一整天
lines.en: I can sit like this the whole day

lines.zh: 你得低头才能看我
lines.en: You have to look down to see me

lines.zh: 我仰起头，你的脸在很远的地方
lines.en: I look up, and your face is very far away

lines.zh: 你这么大，我一伸手就够不着
lines.en: You are so large, I cannot reach at all

lines.zh: 别踩，我就在你脚前
lines.en: Do not step, I am right before your feet

lines.zh: 我的眼睛是两个点
lines.en: My eyes are two dots

lines.zh: 你笑的时候，我这张脸也在笑
lines.en: When you smile, this face of mine smiles too

lines.zh: 我在这个角落待了很久
lines.en: I have been in this corner a long while

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我就看得清了
lines.en: Crouch down and I can see you properly

lines.zh: 我这一身绒布，摸起来像旧的
lines.en: This plush of mine feels worn

lines.zh: 你叫我什么？我记得名字写在牌子上
lines.en: What did you call me? My name is on the tag

lines.zh: 你站着，我仰着
lines.en: You stand, I look up

lines.zh: 你影子罩下来，我整张脸都黑了
lines.en: Your shadow falls and my whole face goes dark

lines.zh: 我在你的膝盖下面，别踢到我
lines.en: I am below your knee, do not kick me

lines.zh: 这么圆一张脸，你没法装作没看见
lines.en: A face this round, you cannot pretend not to see it

lines.zh: 我这张脸是缝上去的，拆不开
lines.en: This face is stitched on, it does not come off

lines.zh: 你站了这么久，我一直仰着
lines.en: You have stood there this long and I have kept looking up

lines.zh: 门口的风，都吹到我这一角来了
lines.en: The draft from the door reaches my corner

lines.zh: 绒布蹭掉了一块
lines.en: A patch of plush has rubbed off

lines.zh: 我滚出去，停了
lines.en: I rolled off and stopped

lines.zh: 耳朵凹进去了
lines.en: My ear is dented in

lines.zh: 圆身子晃了好久
lines.en: The round body rocked a long while

lines.zh: 我躺下了，站不起来
lines.en: I am down and cannot right myself

lines.zh: 棉花露出来一点
lines.en: A little stuffing shows

lines.zh: 打起我来，真是欺负小的
lines.en: Striking me really is bullying the small

lines.zh: 我脸上的笑还是那样
lines.en: The smile on my face is unchanged

lines.zh: 这一下，缝线开了
lines.en: That split a seam

lines.zh: 我还在这儿，你抬头看看
lines.en: I am still here, look down

lines.zh: 我这嘴是画的
lines.en: This mouth of mine is painted on

lines.zh: 你蹲下来给我看，倒是用心
lines.en: You crouch down to show me, that is kind

lines.zh: 我肚子里什么都没有
lines.en: There is nothing in my belly

lines.zh: 这么小一块，比我手还大
lines.en: That small piece is bigger than my hand

lines.zh: 放地上吧，我拿不动
lines.en: Leave it on the floor, I cannot lift it

lines.zh: 我不吃，就看看
lines.en: I do not eat, I will just look

lines.zh: 你举低一点，我仰头看不见
lines.en: Hold it lower, I cannot see from down here

lines.zh: 我不饿，这身子没有饿的时候
lines.en: I am not hungry, this body never gets hungry

lines.zh: 你把它收起来吧，别放这么久
lines.en: Put it away, do not hold it out so long

lines.zh: 我帮你看着，等别人来拿
lines.en: I will watch it until someone comes for it

lines.zh: 你踩一下，我就滚出去老远
lines.en: Step on me and I roll a long way

lines.zh: 圆的东西，一碰就翻
lines.en: A round thing tips at the slightest touch

lines.zh: 我在你脚前面，很容易被忘
lines.en: I am right in front of your feet and easily forgotten

lines.zh: 我躺下了，腿朝上
lines.en: I am down with my legs up

lines.zh: 你把我扶起来的时候，我歪着
lines.en: When you set me up, I was crooked

lines.zh: 这一撞，耳朵瘪了一块
lines.en: That dented one ear

lines.zh: 我滚到墙角才停
lines.en: I rolled to the corner before stopping

lines.zh: 别用脚尖轻轻踢我
lines.en: Do not nudge me with your toe

lines.zh: 这么轻的绒布，也会疼吗？不知道
lines.en: Can plush this light feel pain? I do not know

lines.zh: 你得把我摆正，我才好看
lines.en: You have to set me straight or I look wrong

lines.zh: 我是摆在角落里的，没有伴
lines.en: I am set in a corner, no companion

lines.zh: 圆人不跟人配
lines.en: A round one does not pair with a person

lines.zh: 你要蹲下来跟我说这个吗
lines.en: Are you crouching to say that to me

lines.zh: 我只有这么高，抱不到谁
lines.en: I am only this tall, I cannot hold anyone

lines.zh: 这块牌子上的名字，是给我的
lines.en: The name on this tag is mine

lines.zh: 我的手脚都是缝的
lines.en: My hands and feet are stitched on

lines.zh: 这种话，角落里的东西听不懂
lines.en: Such words a corner thing does not understand

lines.zh: 你让我安静坐着就好
lines.en: Just let me sit quietly

lines.zh: 我连点头都不太容易
lines.en: I cannot even nod easily

lines.zh: 说完就站直吧，我都得仰着
lines.en: Stand up when you finish, I have to crane up

lines.zh: 这东西比我还高
lines.en: The thing stands taller than I do

lines.zh: 我伸手，够到一半
lines.en: I reach and get halfway

lines.zh: 圆手上什么东西都夹不住
lines.en: These round hands cannot grip anything

lines.zh: 它倒下来，压在我身上
lines.en: It toppled and landed on me

lines.zh: 你拿走吧，我只要看着
lines.en: Take it, I only want to watch

lines.zh: 我滚过去，把它顶了一下
lines.en: I rolled over and nudged it

lines.zh: 滚到我肚子底下了
lines.en: It rolled under my belly

lines.zh: 我够不着，就坐着
lines.en: I cannot reach it, so I sit

lines.zh: 这东西在这儿，没人认领
lines.en: Nobody has claimed it here

lines.zh: 我挪一挪，让出个地方
lines.en: I shift to make a little room

lines.zh: 有脚步声，从走廊那边
lines.en: Footsteps, from down the corridor

lines.zh: 我仰着头看，看不到那么高
lines.en: I look up, as high as I cannot see

lines.zh: 我在这儿，一直都在
lines.en: I am here, I have always been

lines.zh: 椅子腿挡着我一半视线
lines.en: The chair legs block half my view

lines.zh: 你从门口进来，我就看见了
lines.en: I saw you the moment you came in

lines.zh: 圆脸不会转，可是对着门的
lines.en: The round face cannot turn, but it points at the door

lines.zh: 你没注意到角落里
lines.en: You did not notice the corner

lines.zh: 这一层的人，都知道我在
lines.en: Everyone on this floor knows I am here

lines.zh: 我闻不到什么，只听见
lines.en: I cannot smell anything, I only hear

lines.zh: 你不会想到要找我
lines.en: You would not think to look for me

lines.zh: 地板的响动，一步一步过来
lines.en: The floor sounds come step by step

lines.zh: 我挪不动，只能看着
lines.en: I cannot move, I can only watch

lines.zh: 门缝的灯照到了我半张脸
lines.en: The door gap's light catches half my face

lines.zh: 谁在那儿站着，不动
lines.en: Whoever is standing there, is not moving

lines.zh: 你要低头找，才看得见我
lines.en: You must look down to find me

lines.zh: 这一下，躲也躲不了
lines.en: Now there is no dodging

lines.zh: 你还在屋里，我听得出来
lines.en: You are still in the room, I can tell

lines.zh: 我耳朵贴在地板上
lines.en: My ear rests against the floor

lines.zh: 这间屋子的门，声音一响我就知道
lines.en: The moment this room's door sounds, I know

lines.zh: 你走的每一步，都路过了什么
lines.en: What each of your steps passes by

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊了也没人应
lines.en: I do not call out, nobody would answer

lines.zh: 桌子底下的影子变了
lines.en: The shadow under the table has changed

lines.zh: 我滚过来一点，看清了
lines.en: I rolled a little closer and saw clearly

lines.zh: 我身上又落了一层灰
lines.en: Another layer of dust has settled on me

lines.zh: 你绕着桌子走，我跟着转
lines.en: You circle the table, and I turn with you

lines.zh: 灯管一闪，屋里暗了
lines.en: The tube flickered and the room darkened

lines.zh: 我离门很近，比你想象得近
lines.en: I am closer to the door than you think

lines.zh: 你说话的声音都低了
lines.en: Your voice has gone quiet

lines.zh: 角落不藏人，只藏我
lines.en: Corners do not hide people, only me

lines.zh: 你听得见圆东西滚吗
lines.en: Can you hear a round thing roll

lines.zh: 我这一身都在响
lines.en: Everything in me is creaking

lines.zh: 你一停下，就离我不远
lines.en: When you stop, you are not far from me

lines.zh: 这个影子，不是椅子
lines.en: That shadow is not a chair

lines.zh: 我要是能站起来，早站了
lines.en: If I could stand, I would have long ago

lines.zh: 我滚过去，撞你的脚踝
lines.en: I roll into your ankle

lines.zh: 这点重量，也不算轻
lines.en: This weight is not exactly light

lines.zh: 你踩到我，脚下一滑
lines.en: You stepped on me and your foot slid

lines.zh: 圆边刮了你一下
lines.en: A round edge scraped you

lines.zh: 我顶在你小腿上
lines.en: I brace against your shin

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，也咬你一口
lines.en: A thing this small can still bite

lines.zh: 你踢开我，我撞到了墙
lines.en: You kicked me and I hit the wall

lines.zh: 你退了三步，我才停下
lines.en: You backed three paces before I stopped

lines.zh: 我弹起来，落在你跟前
lines.en: I bounced and landed in front of you

lines.zh: 你看着脚下，脸色变了
lines.en: You look down and your face changes

lines.zh: 这一身布，比我看着的重
lines.en: This plush is heavier than it looks

lines.zh: 你脚边的东西，不一定安静
lines.en: Things by your feet are not always quiet

lines.zh: 我顶翻了你的椅子腿
lines.en: I tipped your chair leg

lines.zh: 你被绊了一下，没摔
lines.en: You tripped and did not fall

lines.zh: 我滚回来，又碰了你
lines.en: I rolled back and hit you again

lines.zh: 这角落，我守了很久
lines.en: I have watched this corner a long while

lines.zh: 角落里多了一个圆东西
lines.en: A round thing has appeared in the corner

lines.zh: 我被放在地毯上，正对着门
lines.en: I was set on the rug, facing the door

lines.zh: 这个位置，正好能看见走廊
lines.en: This spot sees the corridor nicely

lines.zh: 我这么矮，得有人低头找
lines.en: Being this low, someone must look down to find me

lines.zh: 灯光斜着，我的脸一半亮
lines.en: The light comes slantwise, half my face glows

lines.zh: 地毯上的灰被蹭开一圈
lines.en: A ring of dust is rubbed off the rug

lines.zh: 我没被摆在显眼的地方
lines.en: They did not put me anywhere prominent

lines.zh: 一双旧鞋挨着我的脚
lines.en: An old pair of shoes sits by my feet

lines.zh: 这里本来有个孩子坐过
lines.en: A child used to sit here

lines.zh: 我被摆正，然后关灯
lines.en: I was set straight, then the lights went out

lines.zh: 一进门，先看见的是我的圆脸
lines.en: The first thing at the door is my round face

lines.zh: 这间餐厅的角落，又满了
lines.en: The diner's corner is full again

lines.zh: 旧箱子里搬出来的，全是灰
lines.en: Taken from an old crate, all dust

lines.zh: 我的位置不在台上，在角落
lines.en: My place is not the stage, but the corner

lines.zh: 这块地毯是我压着的
lines.en: This rug is the one I weigh down

lines.zh: 一摆好，我就不再动了
lines.en: Once set in place, I never move again

lines.zh: 台上有大的，角落有小的
lines.en: The big ones on the stage, the small one in the corner

lines.zh: 灯的影子落在墙上，是我的圆头像
lines.en: The lamp casts my round head on the wall

lines.zh: 绒布一烧就收，缩成一团
lines.en: The plush shrank and curled in the fire

lines.zh: 我从桌上滚下去，滚了很远
lines.en: I rolled off the table and kept going

lines.zh: 水把它泡胀了，我沉下去
lines.en: Water swelled it and I sank

lines.zh: 炸得我翻了个个儿
lines.en: The blast flipped me over

lines.zh: 一支箭穿了我的肚子
lines.en: An arrow went through my belly

lines.zh: 一股劲儿钻进棉花里
lines.en: A force worked into the stuffing

lines.zh: 我这身子不会饿，只会旧
lines.en: This body does not starve, it only grows old

lines.zh: 一道白光，角落全亮了
lines.en: A white flash lit the whole corner

lines.zh: 这里没有地板，我滚不动
lines.en: No floor here, and I cannot roll
